description: This file contains unit tests for hash algorithms using the Google Test framework. It tests the functionality of hashing files with various algorithms (MD5, SHA1, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512), including creating, appending data, saving/loading hash contexts, and verifying hashes against system commands.

classes.name: SignedFileType
classes.description: A template class for handling signed files with hash calculation, supporting multiple hash algorithms.

methods.name: GetSystemHash
methods.description: Extracts the first token from a string buffer, used to parse system command output.

methods.name: ExecuteCmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and captures its output, used to verify hash values against system utilities.

methods.name: HashStringToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal hash string into a byte array.

methods.name: HashBytesToString
methods.description: Converts a byte array representing a hash into a hexadecimal string.
